rendering.frame_selection: emotion + mouth + eyes; use precomposited PNG frames or three-layer composition
rendering.export_note: 512px canvas adds transparent margins, not extra image detail.

speech.amplitude_adapter: mouth shapes are approximate. Select small/open with output-audio amplitude; use round/wide/narrow when timed phoneme/viseme cues are available.
speech.on_interruption: return mouth to rest within 80ms; keep current emotion, optionally blink

emotion_transition.priority: use sustained dialogue intent, not emotion changes on each syllable

integration_contract.source: This is an asset contract, not an OpenAI API event schema. A future app supplies these fields.
integration_contract.network_or_processing_wait: mouth rest; keep blink and subtle idle motion
integration_contract.warning: Previews demonstrate animation only. No live audio or API connection is included.

previews.purpose: Illustrative timing demo, not a recording or live audio synchronization.
